capabilities: Insert special symbols without switching keyboard layout
Wrap selections with Markdown pairs and bracket helpers
Toggle blockquotes, bullet lists, and code blocks
Increase or decrease heading levels on the current line
Toggle the case of selected text
disambiguation: Not a hotkey manager; it only adds editor commands that users assign themselves under Settings -> Hotkeys.
extras: Version 3.0.0 deliberately ships no default hotkeys; users must assign commands themselves in Settings -> Hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for typing characters like «» or em dashes on a non-matching keyboard layout, so users must switch layouts or retype manually.
summary: Editor command set that inserts special symbols without switching keyboard layout and applies common Markdown edits via assignable hotkeys.
